purpose: Review city-local registry basis and anonymous geometry-only route without querying personal/property attributes.
registryBasis: Nara City’s Asset Tax Division publishes a city-wide parcel-reference map (“地番図”) as CC BY 2.1 Japan open data, including shapefile boundary layers. The 2025-01-01 snapshot contains 414,023 boundary polygons. Three nearest complete sample polygons are valid in native EPSG:2448 and covered by the union of relevant official Nara City 大字界 subdivision polygons, confirming city binding. The city says the map is for reference and does not evidence rights or exact legal boundaries.

Nara City’s Asset Tax Division publishes a city-wide parcel-reference map (“地番図”) as CC BY 2.1 Japan open data, including shapefile boundary layers. The 2025-01-01 snapshot has 414,023 boundary polygons; three nearest complete native shapes were retained as a bounded sample. The city explicitly says the map is only a reference, not an authoritative boundary/rights record, and does not guarantee positional accuracy.

searchQueries.result: Nara City’s official open-data page lists parcel-map shapefile layers and CC BY 2.1 Japan reuse conditions. The page dates the data 2025-01-01 and warns that the map is only a reference, may differ from cadastral maps, and is not evidence of rights or exact boundaries. The map portal also lists parcel map layers.
